title.es: El picnic de cumpleaños de Mia

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A1 con un texto original sobre birthday plans.
intro.en: Practise A1 English reading with an original text about birthday plans.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: Mia is having a birthday picnic in Riverside Park on Sunday. Please arrive at eleven and bring a hat because there is little shade. Her family will bring sandwiches, fruit, and lemonade. You can bring a small game if you like. If it rains, the picnic will move to Mia’s flat at 24 King Street. Please text her before Friday to say if you can come.
content.plainTextForAnalysis: Mia is having a birthday picnic in Riverside Park on Sunday. Please arrive at eleven and bring a hat because there is little shade. Her family will bring sandwiches, fruit, and lemonade. You can bring a small game if you like. If it rains, the picnic will move to Mia’s flat at 24 King Street. Please text her before Friday to say if you can come.
